title: MSFS 2024 NEW Airports & Scenery: KVGT, KCDC, MUCC + Amsterdam & PHNL Lighting!
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update (March 22, 2026): New MSFS 2024 Airports & Night Lighting! This week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for PC features essential scenery upgrades, including the busy KVGT North Las Vegas Airport and the challenging LOJC Kitzbühel heliport.

If you are looking for the best MSFS 2024 scenery addons or want to improve your MSFS 2024 night lighting, this update includes over 20 new city and airport illumination packs for a more realistic Night VFR experience.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 DC Scenery Design: MUCC Cayo Coco (Cuban island destination with scenic coastal approaches)
🛫 MSFSceneryBuilders: KCDC Cedar City Regional Airport (Utah regional gateway)
🛫 MSFSceneryBuilders: KVGT North Las Vegas Airport (Busy GA hub near the Vegas Strip)
🛫 NewAgeStudios: SBBQ Major Brigadeiro Doorgal Borges Airport (Brazilian regional airport)
🛫 Redfox Simulation: LOJC Kitzbuhel heliport (Challenging alpine heli operations)
